meta_title: S. Storey & Son | Painter & Decorator Newcastle
meta_description: S. Storey & Son Ltd is a trusted painter and decorator in Newcastle. Interior and exterior painting, wallpapering, and decorative finishes. Free quotes.
hero_subhead: Transform your home with expert interior and exterior painting. We take pride in every finish, and we're fully insured and reliable.
services_heading: Complete Painting & Decorating Services Across Newcastle
services_subhead: From interior redecorating to exterior masonry work, we handle every job with meticulous attention to detail and professional finishes.

services.title: Interior Painting & Decorating
services.desc: Full interior redecoration including walls, ceilings, woodwork, and feature walls. We prep, prime, and finish to a high standard, protecting your furniture and floors throughout.

services.title: Exterior Painting & Masonry
services.desc: Weather-resistant exterior painting for rendered, brick, and wooden surfaces. We use quality exterior paints and ensure proper surface preparation for long-lasting results.

services.title: Wallpapering & Wall Coverings
services.desc: Professional wallpaper hanging including pattern matching, feature walls, and specialist coverings. Includes removal of old wallpaper and surface preparation.

services.title: Woodwork & Joinery Painting
services.desc: Skirting boards, doors, frames, and fitted furniture painted to a flawless finish. We sand, prime, and apply multiple coats for durability and a smooth, professional look.

services.title: Timber Treatment & Protection
services.desc: Protective treatments for exterior timber, fencing, and outbuildings. Extends the life of wood and enhances weather resistance with quality-grade sealants.

services.title: Consultation & Colour Advice
services.desc: Free on-site consultation to discuss colour schemes, finishes, and timeline. We help you choose the right products and prepare an accurate, transparent quote.

about_pullquote: We do every job as if we're painting our own home.
about_para_1: S. Storey & Son Ltd has been serving Newcastle and the surrounding areas for over 20 years. Founded by Steve Storey, the business has built a reputation for meticulous preparation, quality finishes, and straightforward pricing. We're fully insured, reliable, and take pride in being the decorator our neighbours would recommend.
about_para_2: Our customers return to us because we listen, deliver on time, and treat every property with respect. Whether it's a single-room refresh or a full-house renovation, we bring the same professional standards and friendly approach. We're not the flashiest, but we're the decorators you can trust.
reviews_heading: What Newcastle Homeowners Say About Us

reviews.text: Steve came to quote for our whole house repaint and gave us a fair price with no pressure. Did the work on time, was tidy, and the finish is immaculate. Couldn't fault him. Will definitely have him back for the upstairs.
reviews.author: Michael T.

reviews.text: Had a nightmare with stained walls and old wallpaper. Steve and his team stripped everything back, prepped properly, and the new finish looks amazing. Professional from start to finish, and they cleaned up after themselves. Highly recommend.
reviews.author: Claire H.

reviews.text: Not the cheapest quote we got, but worth every penny. You can see the care taken in the prep work and the finish is miles better than the last decorator we used. Will be calling them again for the kitchen next year.
reviews.author: David P.
